what: A Chart.js pie chart draws clockwise from the top over 2s easeOutQuart, and the plate shrinks from 1.2x to its normal size over 1.6s power2.out (.1s delay). Slices go in this order: deep accent, lime green, pale checker pattern, dot pattern, white, light accent, pale gray, each with a 1px dark outline. Slices over 3% get a percent label at the center (radius .6) that rises in over .6s after .8s. Every fx:draw received redraws from the start. With shuffle: on, only two slices (dot pattern, white) remain: after 1.4s it fills 0→80% over 2s, then every 2 to 5 seconds switches to one of 9:1 to 1:9 over 1.8s (a logo where the digit 0 is a pie chart)

options.data: Piece values (space-separated) — e.g. "39 38 17 4 2". Drawn by ratio even if the total isn’t 100
options.colors: Color slot per piece (1~7, space-separated), default "1 2 3 4 5 6 7" — 1 accent · 2 lime · 3 pale grid pattern · 4 dot pattern · 5 white · 6 light accent · 7 pale gray. Colors change via --fx-pie-1…7
options.start: view (once when 85% of it is on screen, default) · load (immediately) · wait (only when fx:draw is received)
options.grow: Scale at which the board starts to shrink, default 1.2 — at 1 it does not shrink
options.grow-on: Attribute to shrink: width·height, default width (the original hero uses height)
options.size: Final size (%) — end value of the grow-on attribute, default 100
options.labels: If off, percent text is not shown
options.label-min: Minimum value to float text, default 3
options.shuffle: If on, logo type — two pieces change at a random ratio every few seconds
options.delay: seconds until the first fill of shuffle, default 1.4
options.loop: If off, shuffle only does the first fill-up, with no random swapping
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]: Canvas to draw on (optional, created if missing)
options.--fx-pie-1…7 · --fx-pie-line · --fx-pie-: Piece color · ink line · text color (text on dark pieces) · text size

note: The original overlaid percent text as SVG images — here positions are computed from the piece values and shown as real text. Pattern images (dots, grid) are drawn on a canvas at the same spacing instead of the original png

from.where: index.html .ak-pie (hero survey card · question-row graph) · .ak-logo__pie (shuffle in the 0 slot of the logo)
